artifacts.summary: Confirms skill-literature's Mode: Convert bypasses literature-convert.sh's engine tiers and quality gate; recommends delegating Convert Step 3b's text extraction to literature-convert.sh (mirroring literature-ingest.sh's exit-code-handling pattern) rather than bolting the gate onto the inline pdftotext path.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo's literature extension, skill-literature/SKILL.md is a direct-execution skill: its numbered 'Steps' are prose/pseudocode that an agent executes live via Bash/AskUserQuestion tool calls, not a standalone shell script. literature-convert.sh is the single gated, tiered (pymupdf4llm primary / PyMuPDF column-clustering fallback / pdftotext last-resort-explicit-only) PDF/DJVU-to-markdown converter with a loud-failure quality gate (exit 3 = rejected, .rejected sibling written instead of .md). literature-ingest.sh already shows the correct caller pattern for it: capture exit code explicitly via `if VAR=$(cmd); then EXIT=0; else EXIT=$?; fi` (safe under set -e), then branch on exit 3 (grep -m1 'QUALITY GATE FAILED' from captured stderr, skip the file, never write an index entry) vs exit 1/2 (hard failure, skip) vs exit 0 (success, glob-match the tmp dir's single .md file for the actual output rather than reconstructing its name, since literature-convert.sh internally lower-cases/sanitizes its own doc_id differently than a caller's own naming convention might).
